name: ModelVariant148_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant148_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the entry launches shells from one of the slot's parts that spin towards points on a ring in front of the other slot, then burst into sparks behind an optional screen flash. A negative command draws a frame; any other command sets the work area up and prints its size); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-165 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant165_entry.c with GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT, VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
